project_type: Multi-module Maven monorepo: Spring Boot (Java 17 source level) microservices (xamops-service, billops, media-ops-service, api-gateway, service-registry, permissions-common) + a React/TypeScript/Vite frontend (frontend-app) + nginx edge (api-gateway/nginx-prod.conf).
language: Java (Spring Boot) for backend; TypeScript/React for frontend; nginx conf.
build_system: Maven multi-module (root pom lists modules xamops-service, billops, media-ops-service, api-gateway, service-registry, permissions-common). NO maven wrapper (no ./mvnw) — use system `mvn` (3.9.x present). Frontend uses npm + Vite. xamops-service surefire excludes the `containers` test group by default (surefire.excludedGroups=containers), so plain `mvn test` runs the fast suite; container ITs need -Dgroups=containers and are NOT run here.
build_command: Backend per-module compile happens as part of `mvn test`. Frontend build: from frontend-app run `npm run build` (= icons:bundle && tsc && vite build).
test_command: xamops-service: `mvn test -B --no-transfer-progress -pl xamops-service -am` (run from the worktree root). billops: `mvn test -B --no-transfer-progress -pl billops -am` (from worktree root). frontend-app: `npm test` (= vitest run) from the frontend-app dir; demo-only subset: `npx vitest run src/demo`. These exact commands come from .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml.
verification_instructions: 1) Phase A (schema) must land first (migration + both Client entities + ClientRepository.findFirstByDemoTrue + DataInitializer seeding) because xamops gates/provisioning and the billops derived query all reference Client.demo. 2) After each FEAT run that FEAT's verification commands from the paths above. 3) The three DEMO_EMAILS set-equality tests MUST stay green (AutoSpottingAdminControllerTest.demoAccountList_matchesTheOtpExemptLogins, K8sAutomationAccessServiceTest, AutomationWritePermissionTest) — never modify any DEMO_EMAILS static set. 4) Integration pass: run both backend test commands + frontend build + frontend test; confirm both services boot against the shared schema with only client.is_demo added. 5) Clean up temp files; commit locally on the branch, never push.
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend-app `npm run build` runs `icons:bundle` (scripts/generate-icon-bundle.mjs) which may regenerate an icon bundle; run the full `npm run build` rather than bare `vite build` so the icon bundle stays consistent. No other generated/checked-in snapshot files are known for this task.

key_patterns: xamops Client is Lombok @Data @NoArgsConstructor with Client(String name) ctor and @Column(unique=true) name; sibling booleans use `@Column(name=..., columnDefinition="boolean default false")`. billops Client is likewise @Data. Both OAuth controllers are @Slf4j (field `log`), inject ClientRepository + PasswordEncoder, and in callback have an existing-user branch (establishSession -> redirectUrl) and a new-user branch (issueSignupToken -> /signup/complete). UserRepository.findByGoogleSub/findByEmail JOIN FETCH u.client (client is eager on those paths). SessionService.establishSession(User,request,PROVIDER_*) calls UserActivityService.recordLogin which writes a LOGIN row (action='LOGIN', auth_provider). UserActivityEvent (xamops) has ACTION_LOGIN='LOGIN', PROVIDER_GOOGLE='GOOGLE', PROVIDER_MICROSOFT='MICROSOFT'. Four write-gates key on demo emails: K8sAutomationAccessService.userDecision, AutoSpottingAdminAccess.isDemoAccount, AutomationWritePermission.decide, SystemActorResolver.isNotDemo (static, used as ::isNotDemo). LoginOtpController holds the private DEMO_EMAILS set the three equality tests compare against. billops User and AppUser are MINIMAL mappings (no authProvider/lastLoginAt) in package com.xammer.cloud.domain; source provider/times from user_activity_event LOGIN rows only. billops admin endpoints guard with @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('ROLE_BILLOPS_ADMIN','ROLE_BILLOPS_ADMIN_SUB')") (SupportAdminController). Frontend demoConfig.ts exports DEMO_MODE_KEY/DEMO_ROLE_KEY/isDemoMode/getDemoRole/DEMO_EMAILS/activateDemoModeIfNeeded (demoRouter.test.ts depends on the keys). demoRouter PASSTHROUGH_PATTERNS already includes /api/auth/, /logout, /api/xamops/user/profile, /api/billops/profile. App.tsx BILLOPS_ADMIN_TAB_ROUTES object + BILLOPS_ADMIN_TAB_ORDER=Object.keys(...). Sidebar BillOps admin items are flat NavItems gated by isTabAllowed('<key>'). nginx-prod.conf has one `server { server_name live.xamops.com; }` and every location sets `proxy_set_header Host $host;`; no X-Forwarded-Host anywhere.
